description: This file defines the 'ProductAttributeDao' interface, which extends a generic DAO interface to provide data access methods for ProductAttribute entities. It includes method signatures for retrieving product attributes based on various criteria such as option ID, option value ID, associated product, and attribute IDs.

classes.name: ProductAttributeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for ProductAttribute entities, providing methods to fetch product attributes based on different filters.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects associated with a specific option ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects associated with a specific option value ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects linked to a specific product within a merchant store and for a given language.

methods.name: getByAttributeIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductAttribute objects matching a list of attribute IDs within a merchant store.
